# VI read-only presentation candidates — M52

**All files here are candidate-only, not approved shared wire contracts, not host-mounted and not frontend-integrated.** Examples are generated by local implementations or are explicitly synthetic (`EXPERIMENTAL_DEMO_DATA_ONLY`); fake fixture hashes are not source evidence. `*.schema.json` are generated Pydantic JSON Schemas and `*.example.json` are validated fixtures. Outer quality/SBOM schemas intentionally leave `evidence`/`inventory` as objects; `quality_evidence_core.schema.json` and `inventory.schema.json` document their core structures. Quality's `derived_ages` and `unresolved_observations` are additional documented v1 evidence fields, not included in the core model schema; these are presentation candidates, not complete wire validation for untrusted callers. Pydantic models and fixtures are contract-tested in `test_frontend_vi_candidates.py`; conflict candidate validation also runs against synthetic data in real disposable PostgreSQL.

| Candidate | Implementation/status | UI guidance |
|---|---|---|
| `quality` | `quality_document`, v1 local library | Render `unknown`, `missing_evidence`, `stale_evidence` and `conflict` distinctly. A caller-declared complete consultation without an observation is not a negative vulnerability finding. Show source, provenance, collection time and explicit horizon. |
| `sbom` | `sbom_summary`, v1 local library | Show supported subset/format, original SHA, origin/provenance, ignored fields and unknown inventory completeness. Components present do not imply affected or safe. |
| `conflict` | `conflict_document`, v1 read-only local DB library | Show both hashes, first-observed and collection/release timestamps, changed IDs. Neither side wins; raw bytes require separately authorized operator access. |
| `resolution_availability` | `resolution_availability`, v1 static library availability statement | `not_implemented`, `persistent_history_available=false` says capability unavailable, **not** that a specific conflict has no resolutions. Never manufacture a conflict-level status. |

Frontend must distinguish loading, unavailable, partial, unknown, stale, conflict and source error states; do not use zero, green or safe as substitutes for unknown. Escape provider text and enforce display/access limits. No UI fetch is authorized until Agent 1 and Agent 4 approve host-owned tenant/permission, BFF route and wire/error semantics. Preserve browser create-only write boundary `POST /api/v1/coordination/tasks`. Actual frontend implementation and tests are unverified here.
